interest: Japanese navy reserved drydocks; the disabled West Cusseta sought space.
overview: List of Papers for 894.1564: Grew's telegrams on naval limits on foreign repairs and drydock space for the West Cusseta.

subfiles.about: Telegram reporting naval restrictions on Japanese dockyards accepting advance repair bookings for foreign steamships.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports naval orders barring Japanese dockyards from accepting foreign repair orders over thirty days ahead.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Grew on restriction of foreign steamship repairs

subfiles.about: Telegram regarding the availability of drydock facilities at Yokohama for the disabled American vessel West Cusseta.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports the rudderless West Cusseta towed to Yokohama; drydocks are full, but Japan will try to free space.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Grew on drydock accommodation for the West Cusseta
